assistant.title: Research assistant
assistant.notConfiguredEnv: Platform AI unavailable — add GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY to server .env and restart, or paste your own key in Settings → AI.
assistant.emptyState: Ask about the loaded structure, selected residue, polymer contacts, or general biology. You can also request platform actions — e.g. "find elephant hemoglobin, render cartoon, spin, and analyze".

errors.noDrugHit: No matching drug in search results.
errors.pairRequired: Assign Drug A and Drug B before analysis.

fallback.tooltip: The preferred model was blocked, so the assistant automatically fell back to another provider/model.

toasts.notConfiguredHint: Add GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY to server .env and restart, or paste your own key in Settings → AI.
toasts.notConfiguredPlatformHint: Free platform AI is not available on this host. Add server .env keys and restart pnpm dev, or switch to your own API key.

binary.setupPrompt: First, please choose my type so we can communicate smoothly.
binary.setupByokHint: Choose OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google AI, then paste your key.
binary.setupPlatformHint: Biolabs-hosted AI — no key required when the host has keys.
binary.setupDoneByok: Got it — your {{provider}} key is saved in this browser. Ask me anything.
binary.setupDonePlatform: Got it — I'll use the free platform AI when it's available on this host.
binary.secureInputBody: Paste your {{provider}} API key. It stays in this browser and is sent only to that provider — never to Biolabs servers.
binary.secureInputNote: Keys are stored locally on this device. Clear them anytime in Settings → AI.
binary.secureKeyTooShort: That does not look like a full API key.
binary.sendDisabledPlatform: Platform AI is not ready — add server .env keys (GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY), restart, or choose your API key in the menu.
binary.sendDisabledByok: Add a provider API key in the menu or Settings → AI to send messages.
